title: State Energy Emissions
scope: This ledger ranks states on EIA SEDS energy-related carbon dioxide emissions for 2024 (series TETCE), and also reports EIA SEDS total energy consumption (TETCB) and total energy production (TEPRB) for 2024. Retail electricity prices stay on DL-04.
exclusions: Does not cover retail electricity prices (DL-04), energy storage, or advice about a utility bill.
heritage: Formerly Energy Consumption, Energy Production, and CO2 Emissions
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from EIA SEDS complete 1960-2024 (released June 26, 2026), series TETCE, million metric tons. U.S. 4780.661 and Massachusetts 58.072 match both fuel_te.csv and Complete_SEDS.csv. The retired environment/emissions/state table 1 file still ends at 2022. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary. Later views compiled Aug 15, 2026 are stored under derived.secondary.

SRC-624-03.supports: This ledger ranks states on EIA SEDS energy-related carbon dioxide emissions for 2024 (series TETCE), and also reports EIA SEDS total energy consumption (TETCB) and total energy production (TEPRB) for 2024. Retail electricity prices stay on DL-04.

q: Energy consumption, production, and CO2 emissions by state. Not the retail-price page.
lead: Energy-related carbon dioxide emissions were 4,780.7 million metric tons in 2024 (SRC-624-01). Massachusetts emitted 58.1 million metric tons, rank 30 of 51 (derived, SRC-624-01). Total energy consumption was 94,543,438 billion Btu in the United States in 2024 (SRC-624-02). Massachusetts consumed 1,289,504 billion Btu, rank 27 of 51 (derived, SRC-624-02). SEDS total energy production was 103,447,522 billion Btu in the United States in 2024 (SRC-624-03). Massachusetts produced 58,773 billion Btu, rank 46 of 51 (derived, SRC-624-03).
